Olubadan Coronation: Traffic Advisory and Road Closure Notice

The Organizing Committee for the coronation of the 44th Olubadan of Ibadanland, His Imperial Majesty Oba Rashidi Ladoja, inaugurated by the Oyo State Government, hereby issues the following traffic advisory.

The coronation ceremony will take place on Friday, September 26, 2025, at the historic Mapo Hall, Ibadan. As part of the security arrangements for the event, and in view of the attendance of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, certain roads will be closed to vehicular movement from 7:00 a.m. on Friday.

Routes affected include: Beere Junction inward Mapo Hall, Born Photo Junction inward Oja’ba, Idi-Arere Junction inward Oja’ba, Itamerin Junction inward Mapo Hall

To ease access, the Committee has approved three official parking areas:

1. Ibadan North Local Government Car Park (opposite Immigration Office, Agodi)
2. Football Field beside Yemetu Police Station
3. Liberty Stadium, Oke Ado

Shuttle buses will be provided to convey invited guests with valid access passes to Mapo Hall.

Vendors and service providers are strongly advised to arrive between 6:00 a.m. and 6:45 a.m. The public is further reminded that only the convoys of the President and the Governor will be permitted to use the restricted routes.

The Committee appeals for the cooperation of all citizens to ensure a smooth and hitch-free coronation ceremony.

#IbadanCoronationweek
#OlubadanArusa

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 20 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 24 September 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Cavite, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Tarlac(San Jose, Concepcion, Bamban, Capas), Pampanga(Mabalacat, Mexico, Santo Tomas, Porac, Angeles, Santa Rita, Minalin, Bacolor, San Fernando, Floridablanca, Macabebe, Masantol, Guagua, Sasmuan, Lubao, Apalit, San Simon), Batangas(San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Taal, Bauan, Mabini, San Luis, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Cuenca, San Jose, San Pascual, Lipa, Ibaan, Batangas City, Lemery, Laurel, Tanauan, Talisay, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Tingloy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, Calaca) and Quezon(Pagbilao, Padre Burgos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
